name: Switcher / Analytics Consent
description: Analytics Consent product scenario for the Switcher component.

controls.name: checked
controls.description: Controlled on/off setting. Parent updates do not emit change notifications.

controls.name: defaultChecked
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial setting, also restored by form reset.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible label. Empty content adds no label slot; zero remains visible.

controls.name: truncate
controls.description: Truncate overflowing label text with an ellipsis. By default the full label wraps.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name, including when there is no visible label.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: External label element IDs; takes native precedence over aria-label.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Exclude the switch from activation, focus navigation and form submission.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require the on state for native form validation.

controls.name: name
controls.description: FormData key. An unnamed switch does not contribute a form field.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Value submitted only when on; it does not control the setting.

controls.name: form
controls.description: ID of an external native form that owns the input.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the native input on mount.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Expand the membrane and clickable label to the container width.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing; toggling it preserves input identity and state.
